title: Every principal restriction of the normalized section keeps the row gap (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, divide each Schur row on survivors `0,1,2,7,8,9` by its diagonal. All 32 subsets of the other five columns, in each of the six rows, have absolute sum strictly below `1-1/5776`.
- Every principal restriction therefore has row gap strictly greater than `1/(16 p^2)=1/5776`. Vertices 0 and 9 use the original per-entry exponent majorants. Vertices 1, 2, 7, and 8 use the enclosed absolute entries divided by their diagonal lower bounds.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one normalized Schur section, not a proof that every principal restriction of the note's reference matrix retains the row gap.
